scope: Consolidation of exactly five user-authorized, research-only approval batches. Additive overlay to existing 267-slot curatorial authority, not a replacement of historic or production registries.
editorialAuthority: USER_EXPLICIT_APPROVAL_OF_PAINTED_WORK; NOT OF A PARTICULAR PHOTOGRAPH OR REASSIGNMENT
policies: Explicit user approval applies to the depicted work and relevant subject across Prayer, never automatically to every possible placement.
Keep unselected options eligible and not rejected. Preserve every earlier explicit rejection, specific-only placement, artwork source, and fixed cover lock.
Do not alter canonical 267-slot registry, live runtime, Mass reader, Rosary bead mapping or special-rite reader in this research PR.
Never rotate fixed covers or replace protected images by inheritance. A suggested slot is not an approved primary cover.
Before release require exact work identification, source object ID, photograph URL and rights evidence, original pixel QA, frame/crop QA, and an actual asset path.
Do not conflate a painting being centuries old with verified worldwide rights to a particular modern photograph.
Existing 267-slot audit is a time-stamped snapshot, not a claim about current live asset coverage.
